title: Turning a dumb AC unit smart (without losing my security deposit)
summary: The author describes a DIY project to make a standard window air conditioner smart using an ESP32 microcontroller with IR control, allowing remote and automated temperature control without modifying the apartment, ensuring no damage to the security deposit.
problem_solved: Transforms a basic, non-smart AC unit into an automated climate control system that can be controlled remotely while maintaining renter-friendly, non-destructive installation.
why_valuable: Provides an affordable DIY alternative to expensive smart AC units, costing around $20-30 in parts while preserving apartment deposits for renters who cannot make permanent modifications.
